summary: Eleven metres of kerb, shorter than a van, with a house 8 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb of the bend on Fifth Avenue, beside the corner house lawn

drivers.seclusion: House 8 m from the kerb, more homes 12-20 m around; fully overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Short kerb on a bend with No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends; no room for a van.
drivers.convention: A car parks on the opposite side; 2P residents-excepted signs.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time at both ends
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun, with tree shade from the south-east.
